subject: Render DELTA7 READY: path_blit full MULTI_TARGET admit, authored v4 draw PASS, TLS16 PASS; fetch snapshot remains
body:
Render DELTA7 final host-only state. No phone/native/publish/commit.

- Multi-output compile: use compiler options2 MULTI_TARGET target_formats[0..count), plan written-mask check. path_blit full three-output pair now admits true-MRT (active=7, main=0) instead of the old “use the _rt entry” refusal.
- Per-target blends: render sidecar has TeguAIRRenderBlend blends[4], computes from genericRtBlends, validates mask; compositor selects N2MB_RENDER_TARGETS_BLEND_VERSION when the bridge exposes it. Current compute bridge header/implementation has version2.
- Host real bridge/fake JM, both ASan binaries PASS (rc0):
  * real path_blit full pipeline true-MRT; attachment2 fetch is refused before submission (TEGU_DRAW_SILENT rc=-11, status5, 3 clear jobs, no false draw).
  * authored mrt_vertex/mrt_fragment writes outputs0,1,2 without fetch: sidecar count3 formats80,80,10, version2 blends, status4 via n2mb_draw_v4.
  * real asg pair TLS16 sidecar tls16, status4.
  * prior path_cubic, inert, v3/flat/v2/ASTC/CPU all green; ARM64 default+inert syntax PASS.
- Remaining gap: path_blit needs exact per-target attachment snapshot support in compute bridge; direct target sampling/removing the binding would be wrong. true-MRT Load remains refused; only first CLEAR-class v4 job. No hardware claim.
